verdict.rationale: Docs claim Rovo AI 'connects relevant assets and rich data from Confluence, Figma, and your 3rd party apps to your work,' implying strong cross-content search/AI capability, and engineers praise JQL for powerful querying of ticket data. However, community evidence contradicts ease/speed of search: creating a 'useful saved search' is called 'so painful,' and users report chronic slow loading and reload loops that undermine fast, accurate search experiences.
